definitions.explanation: A traditional seasonal festival held on May 5, originally celebrating boys' growth and health. Now a national holiday under the name {こどもの日|こどものひ} (Children's Day).

examples.japanese: {五月五日|ごがついつか}は{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}だ。
{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}には{鯉|こい}のぼりを{立|た}てる。
examples.english: On the Tango Festival, families fly carp streamers.

examples.japanese: {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}に{息子|むすこ}のために{兜|かぶと}を{飾|かざ}り、ちまきを{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: For the Tango Festival I displayed a samurai helmet for my son and prepared chimaki rice dumplings.

notes:
Almost always appears as {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく} (the Tango seasonal festival). The word {端午|たんご} alone is rare in modern speech. Note the homophone {単語|たんご} (vocabulary word) — completely different meaning, different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}: the Tango Festival
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}を{祝|いわ}う: to celebrate the Tango Festival

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
Traditional customs include flying {鯉|こい}のぼり (carp streamers), displaying {兜|かぶと} (samurai helmets) or {五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう} (warrior dolls), eating {柏餅|かしわもち} (oak-leaf mochi) and ちまき (sweet rice dumplings), and bathing in {菖蒲湯|しょうぶゆ} (iris baths). Since 1948, May 5 has officially been {こどもの日|こどものひ} (Children's Day) as a national holiday.
